scope: Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle (2nd ed.), Chapter 6: A Model with Sticky Wages and Prices, with Appendices 6.1-6.2 and Exercises 6.1-6.4. Labour aggregation and wage dispersion; union wage setting over an infinite horizon and the wage NKPC; the gap form and the four-variable system; the determinacy theorem of p. 174 in full (argument principle, homotopy root count, Blanchard-Kahn with one predetermined variable); efficiency and the optimal subsidy; the second-order welfare criterion; limiting cases; optimal commitment policy and the optimality of composite inflation targeting; calibration; and the exercises.
source: Jordi Galí, Monetary Policy, Inflation, and the Business Cycle: An Introduction to the New Keynesian Framework and Its Applications, 2nd ed., Princeton University Press, 2015, Chapter 6, pp. 163-198.
